PAGE TITLE: Undisbursed Balances in Expired Grant Accounts

TABLES:
| Fiscal Year | Total Number of Expired Grants with Undisbursed Balances | Total Amount of Undisbursed Balances for Expired Grants (in thousands) |
|---|---|---|
| 2024 | 975 | $ 12,936 |
| 2023 | 663 | $ 8,126 |
| 2022 | 669 | $ 16,718 |

PHOTOS:
- People attending the Podcast Movement conference at the Gaylord National Resort and Convention Center in National Harbor, Md.
- Caption: NASA Participates in the Podcast Movement conference, Tuesday, Aug. 20, 2024, at the Gaylord National Resort and Convention Center in National Harbor, Md. During the event, NASA hosted a panel entitled, "Eclipses, Moon Missions, and Climate Change: How NASA Reaches Curious Listeners." PHOTO CREDIT – NASA/Bill Ingalls

KEY FACTS:
- In FY 2024, the total number of expired grants with undisbursed balances was 975, with a total amount of $12,936 thousand.
- In FY 2023, the total number of expired grants with undisbursed balances was 663, with a total amount of $8,126 thousand.
- In FY 2022, the total number of expired grants with undisbursed balances was 669, with a total amount of $16,718 thousand.
- Code of Federal Regulations § 200.344 allows grant recipients 120 days to finalize reporting and complete final financial transactions.
